title: Kia & Hyundai ATF Adapter
lead: A new transmission adapter for Kia and Hyundai COGF1 CVT transmissions.
steps: Remove the external cooler from the transmission.
Bolt the adapter directly to the transmission with the same 3 bolts that attach the cooler.
body: Two simple steps make for a quick, reliable transmission fluid exchange.
source: TSB Vol 24 No 1 - New - Kia ATF Adapter.pdf
